code.title: Your clinic code
code.lead: Pet owners can give your clinic permission with this code or by scanning the QR code.
code.qrLabel: QR code of the link for giving your clinic permission

patients.title: Patients
patients.lead: Search the pets you have permission for by name or microchip number.
patients.emptyBody: Only pets whose owners have given your clinic valid permission are listed.

patient.chipHidden: You don't have permission to see the full microchip number.
patient.ownerNoAccess: The owner hasn't given permission to see their contact details.
patient.notFoundBody: Your clinic doesn't have valid permission for this pet.

consents.title: Permissions given to your clinic
consents.lead: Currently valid permissions. Expired or revoked permissions aren't shown here.
consents.emptyBody: Share your clinic code or QR code with pet owners.

stock.title: Stock
stock.lead: Track vaccines, medicines and supplies with critical-level alerts.
stock.name: Item
stock.emptyBody: Add your first item to get started.

stockForm.title: Add an item to stock
stockForm.name: Item name
stockForm.criticalHint: When the quantity drops below this value the item is flagged as critical. Enter 0 for no alert.
stockForm.salePriceHint: Suggested price per unit; you can change it when selling.

stockAdjust.title: Change quantity
stockAdjust.amountHint: For movements other than sales: waste, count corrections, deliveries. Use "Sell" for sales.

stockEdit.title: Edit item
stockEdit.fixedFields: Category and unit can't be changed later.
stockEdit.name: Item name
stockEdit.quantityHint: Enter the actual quantity after a count. Use "Sell" for sales and "Change quantity" for other movements.
stockEdit.criticalHint: When the quantity drops below this value the item is flagged as critical. Enter 0 for no alert.
stockEdit.expiresHint: Optional. Clear the field to remove the date.
stockEdit.noChanges: There are no changes to save.
stockEdit.priceHint: Prices are per unit. Changing a price doesn't affect past sales; a price can't be removed once set.
stockEdit.missingPrices: This item has no prices yet. Enter the purchase and sale price to be able to sell it.

stockDelete.title: Delete item
stockDelete.body: "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted from stock. This can't be undone.

stockSale.title: Record a sale
stockSale.unitPriceHint: Filled with the item's sale price; change it if needed.

sales.title: Sales
sales.lead: Track sales from stock, revenue and profit.

salesReport.chartKeyboard: Daily revenue chart. Use the arrow keys to move between days.

salesHistory.emptyBody: Record your first sale with the "Sell" button on the stock page.
salesHistory.emptyFiltered: No sales in this date range.

saleCancel.title: Cancel sale
saleCancel.restock: {{quantity}} {{unit}} will go back into stock and the sale will be removed from reports.
saleCancel.noRestock: The item was deleted from stock, so nothing goes back into stock; the sale will be removed from reports.
saleCancel.note: Sales can only be cancelled within the month they were made. This can't be undone.
saleCancel.conflict: This sale can no longer be cancelled: it's already cancelled or its month has passed.

profile.title: Clinic details
profile.name: Clinic name
profile.editNote: To change your clinic details, contact us: {{email}}
profile.dangerBody: Once the clinic is deactivated, the clinic account can't sign in again.

deactivate.title: Do you want to deactivate the clinic?
deactivate.point1: The clinic account won't be able to sign in again.
deactivate.point2: Stock and health records won't be deleted.
deactivate.point3: Permissions given to your clinic are not revoked.
deactivate.confirm: I understand the clinic will be deactivated and that this can't be undone.
